first_cause.powershell_error: Cannot bind argument to parameter 'Text' because it is an empty string.
first_cause.explanation: Get-TextSha256 required a nonempty mandatory string and was called for the module stdout before any aggregate transcript was written. The outer regression retained only a missing-transcript marker, so the exact stalled module remained unknown.
first_cause.prohibited_inference: Do not infer which module stalled or invent an internal deadlock cause.

correction: Accept and hash empty streams using the SHA-256 digest of their exact zero-byte content.
Materialize the active module name and pending state before starting its child.
Flush bound executable and package markers immediately from the child bootstrap.
Replace pending frames with returned stdout and stderr before computing per-module metadata.
Distinguish a module-process timeout from exhaustion before the next module starts.
Use millisecond remaining-budget accounting rather than rounding away or extending a sub-second remainder.

additional_cross_examination.finding: Parsing the first candidate-printable 'Ran N tests' stderr line cannot prove the expected focused inventory.
additional_cross_examination.correction: Require exactly one parent-generated terminal marker after unittest returns, bind every module to its pinned expected count, and require the exact 29-module 282-test aggregate.
additional_cross_examination.residual_nonclaim: The marker nonce prevents accidental transcript collision but cannot resist hostile code in the same Python process; exact full-suite and remote controls remain required.

nonclaims: The other fifteen stress executions do not erase the one observed failure.
No exact stalled module or deterministic runtime deadlock has been proven.
